evidence:
Independent source/spec purpose review only: directly read AGENTS.md, PRODUCT-INTENT.md, PRODUCT-CLARIFICATION.md, NEXT_SESSION.md, source.md, spec.md and plan.json. The reviewer did not author the plan or implement the feature. No implementation, live hook delivery, publication or production acceptance is certified by this receipt.
scope: The purpose remains multiple users and sessions linked to persistent projects. Actor/environment/project source keys and actor/environment-scoped resources prevent same labels or UUIDs from silently merging users. Connectivity is supplemental evidence and cannot promote project completion; existing current-revision acceptance and completion tests remain required.
connectivity: Native tool events establish only observed call identity/status. Configured catalog rows and locally reviewed resource maps are declared. Per-resource declared/input/output evidence and explicit artifact references preserve provenance; tool success is explicitly not downstream database audit, unknown artifact references are not verified artifact use, unsupported metadata remains unknown, and Pre/Post observations must not inflate completed execution counts.
kit: Backward-compatible v1 and strict v2 validation cover logger, central transport, model and UI. The fifth detail tab, portfolio dependency filters, scoped relationship text, accessible navigation, safe rendering, import/export and 390px checks directly support the requested central visualization. Canonical bilingual Kit generators/checkers and downloadable source are included; actual native hooks still need their separate evidence before claiming real app delivery.
public: User source expressly authorizes public GitHub, a new Vercel sample and existing Kit links. Parent retains external writes and final integration. The isolated public snapshot must contain sanitized source/tests/docs and synthetic examples only; home git history, settings, private audit backups, real logs and credentials are excluded. This matches publication intent without authorizing publication of personal data. URLs must be verified or corrected before final publication.
Privacy and authority: Exact allowlisted connection fields exclude raw inputs/outputs, URLs, paths, queries and tokens. Malformed optional metadata is dropped with missing_fields while invalid imported v2 is rejected; secret-like data must fail validation. Metadata labels do not establish verified real-world access. No remote sender install, real-user hook trust change, new backend operation or automatic unknown-PC collection is authorized by this plan; automatic collection remains deferred.
Acceptance boundary: Parent must actually run logger/central/transport/dashboard/Kit/harness checks, confirm public visibility and deployed bytes, and exercise desktop/mobile interactions and links. verify_release.py is an implementation obligation, not existing success evidence. Local/synthetic hook-to-central tests and a public static sample cannot satisfy the original product-wide real multi-user delivery criterion, which remains explicitly unclaimed. No purpose-alignment blocker found in the reviewed source/spec.
